answers.core: Plugins are already core and this complements existing functionality. There is clearly already a desire to expose file monitoring to plugins due the current signals, and this change would make that support feature complete.
answers.workaround: The work-around is to cache last modified dates, and re-walk the project directory when the filesystem is changed. This isn't very efficient, and isn't very reliable. It's also a bunch of boilerplate code for what should be a reasonably common operation for a plugin.

title: Implement a signal in EditorFileSystem for when a file is changed by the editor
